capability_question: Can the facility prepare and cast the source-defined candidate and process-matched control without inventing unreported formulation values?
Can the facility apply and verify a controlled crack or defined damage state appropriate to the functional endpoint?
Can the facility measure water-flow or permeability recovery at specimen level with units and uncertainty?
Can the facility control and record the declared healing exposure and timepoints?
Can the facility measure compressive-strength retention as a constraint with batch/specimen lineage?
Can the facility return instrument/run and calibration metadata with uncertainty and missingness?
Can the facility provide microscopy or chemistry characterization if a qualified reviewer decides it is discriminating?
Can the facility return permitted raw or derived files with stable provenance locators?
